map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Hancock, Henry, Morrow and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-24 03:00): mail returned 9,695 (state 8,243); early in person 22,401 (state 19,956). Clermont (as of 2026-10-24 04:16): mail returned 8,671 (state 8,234); early in person 10,131 (state 9,088). Crawford (as of 2026-10-23 15:20): mail returned 1,421 (state 1,340); early in person 2,021 (state 1,881). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-23 18:03): mail returned 70,135 (state 65,252); early in person 24,843 (state 22,194). Franklin (as of 2026-10-24 00:12): mail returned 45,238 (state 43,920); early in person 49,801 (state 44,497); ballots sent 80,919 (state 79,332). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-22 19:44): early in person 33,578 (state 33,345). Hancock: mail returned 1,986 (state 1,836); early in person 5,597 (state 5,182). Henry (as of 2026-10-23 15:21): early in person 1,892 (state 1,756). Morrow (as of 2026-10-23 16:46): mail returned 903 (state 860); early in person 1,972 (state 1,785). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-23 07:31): mail returned 7,252 (state 7,250).
